what: Each time the cursor moves 163px over the board, one work photo (200×120 · corner 8) turns on at the cursor from transparent and .5 scale with a spring (stiffness 500 · damping 60 — about .35s with no overshoot), then 1 second later disappears with the same spring back to transparent and .5 scale. The photo set is reused in rotation — a playful touch on the ‹Contact me› closing board

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photos to drop (children, several) — hidden and cloned for use
options.gap: Cursor distance (px) at which a photo is placed, default 163 (original frequency 10 = 200 − 9 × 199/49)
options.stay: Time until it disappears after lighting up (sec), default 1
options.scale: Size before appearing and after vanishing, default .5
options.--fx-w · --fx-h · --fx-r: Photo size and rounding (via style), default 200px · 120px · 8px

use: …
note: Nothing is applied on touch devices (hover false) or with reduced motion

from.where: index.html closing section .h-cta__trail (whole section z 0 · the text and button block spans the full screen width at z 1, so the trail does not turn on over that strip) — original Framer code component Cursor Image Trail (frequency 10 · visibleFor 1 · 200×120 r8 · in/out opacity 0 scale .5 · spring 500/60/1)
